file.content:
name: Release

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      release_source_sha:
        description: 'Merged managed release-PR commit to recover; leave empty for the triggering commit.'
        required: false
        type: string

permissions: {}

# One run at a time: each run asks `callisto release pending` what is unfinished when it starts, so a run queued behind
# a release sees it finished. GitHub keeps one pending run per group, and the surviving run selects the same release.
concurrency:
  group: release
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  verify:
    name: Verify release candidate
    if: github.event_name == 'push' || inputs.release_source_sha == ''
    timeout-minutes: 45
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Build local Callisto
        uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local

      - name: Install just
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@86f7a0ffb25f40114606501a311ebcfaf882ea32 # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0

      - name: Format Check
        run: just fmt-check

      - name: Clippy Lints
        run: just lint

      - name: Install release verification tools
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@86f7a0ffb25f40114606501a311ebcfaf882ea32 # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-nextest,ripgrep

      - name: Install registry test tools
        uses: $/.github/actions/install-registry-test-tools

      - name: Install workflow linters
        uses: $/.github/actions/install-workflow-linters

      - name: Unit & Integration Tests
        run: just test

      - name: Install cargo-deny
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@86f7a0ffb25f40114606501a311ebcfaf882ea32 # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-deny

      - name: Supply Chain Audit
        run: just audit

      - name: Verify workflow contracts and reject mutable action references
        run: just workflow-contracts

  recovery-checks:
    name: Check release workflow policy for recovery
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.release_source_sha != ''
    timeout-minutes: 10
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install ripgrep
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@86f7a0ffb25f40114606501a311ebcfaf882ea32 # v2
        with:
          tool: ripgrep
      - name: Install just
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@86f7a0ffb25f40114606501a311ebcfaf882ea32 # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0
      - name: Verify release workflow contracts
        run: just release-workflow-checks

  release-candidate:
    name: Identify a merged Callisto release PR
    needs: [verify, recovery-checks]
    # Exactly one gate runs per event; a failed gate matches neither clause.
    if: >-
      always() && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' &&
      ((needs.verify.result == 'success' && needs.recovery-checks.result == 'skipped') ||
       (needs.recovery-checks.result == 'success' && needs.verify.result == 'skipped'))
    timeout-minutes: 10
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      is_release_pr: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.is_release_pr }}
      release_source_sha: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
      release_pr_number: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.release_pr_number }}
      orchestration_sha: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - id: candidate
        shell: bash
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT: ${{ inputs.release_source_sha }}
          TRIGGERING_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          release_source_sha="$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT"
          selected_pending=false
          if [[ -z "$release_source_sha" ]]; then
            release_source_sha=$(callisto --format json release pending | jq -r '.pending[0].source // empty')
            [[ -n "$release_source_sha" ]] && selected_pending=true
            release_source_sha="${release_source_sha:-$TRIGGERING_SHA}"
          fi
          if [[ ! "$release_source_sha" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
            echo "::error::release_source_sha must be exactly 40 lowercase hex characters"
            exit 1
          fi
          resolved_sha=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}" --jq '.sha')
          if [[ "$resolved_sha" != "$release_source_sha" ]]; then
            echo "::error::release_source_sha does not resolve to that exact commit"
            exit 1
          fi
          if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$release_source_sha" "$TRIGGERING_SHA"; then
            echo "::error::release_source_sha is not on main's history"
            exit 1
          fi
          # Attestations are stamped with this run's own SHA, so the
          # coordinator must be exactly the revision running this workflow.
          orchestration_sha="$TRIGGERING_SHA"
          # This only schedules the job. `release plan` verifies the actual
          # parent-to-merge delta; labels and PR metadata are never authority.
          # The GitHub API check is complementary provenance evidence: a
          # trusted merge must be both an actual merge of the managed PR and
          # a GitHub-verified signed commit. It cannot be a direct push.
          prs=$(gh api --paginate "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}/pulls" | jq -s --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --arg sha "$release_source_sha" '[.[][] | select(.merged_at != null and .merge_commit_sha == $sha and .base.ref == "main" and .head.repo.full_name == $repo and (.head.ref == "callisto/version-packages" or (.head.ref | test("^callisto/version-packages--[0-9a-f]{40}$")))) | .number]')
          verified=$(gh api "/repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/commits/${release_source_sha}" --jq '.commit.verification.verified')
          if [[ "$(jq 'length' <<< "$prs")" == 1 && "$verified" == true ]]; then
            {
              echo 'is_release_pr=true'
              echo "release_source_sha=$release_source_sha"
              echo "release_pr_number=$(jq -r '.[0]' <<< "$prs")"
              echo "orchestration_sha=$orchestration_sha"
            } >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          elif [[ "$selected_pending" == true || -n "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA_INPUT" || "$(jq 'length' <<< "$prs")" != 0 ]]; then
            echo "::error::release source is not one verified merged managed PR"
            exit 1
          else
            echo 'is_release_pr=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

  version-pr:
    name: Create or update the Callisto release PR
    needs: [release-candidate, drain]
    if: >-
      always() && needs.release-candidate.result == 'success' &&
      ((needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr != 'true' &&
        needs.drain.result == 'skipped' && inputs.release_source_sha == '') ||
       (needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr == 'true' &&
        needs.drain.result == 'success' && needs.drain.outputs.has_pending == 'false'))
    timeout-minutes: 10
    concurrency:
      group: version-pr
      cancel-in-progress: false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    outputs:
      has_pending_changesets: ${{ steps.version-pr.outputs.hasChangesets }}

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - name: Compose, version, and open the release PR
        id: version-pr
        uses: $/.github/actions/callisto-action
        with:
          setup_callisto: 'false'
          branch: main
          release_branch: callisto/version-packages
          # Interdependent Cargo packages bump together, so Cargo.lock must be refreshed in the release PR.
          version_command: 'callisto version --refresh-lockfiles'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}

  plan:
    name: Derive ephemeral intent from the merged release commit
    needs: release-candidate
    # always(): release-candidate's own ancestors include a gate that is skipped
    # by design, and a skipped ancestor silently skips any job without a status function.
    if: >-
      always() && needs.release-candidate.result == 'success' &&
      needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 20
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      has_artifacts: ${{ steps.slots.outputs.has_artifacts }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # The coordinator must be the current workflow revision. Recovery
          # never rebuilds its release engine from historic source.
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          path: release-source
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Derive and hash intent
        env:
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          ORCHESTRATION_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          handoff_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          mkdir -p "$handoff_dir"
          callisto release plan --source-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source" \
            --orchestration-revision "$ORCHESTRATION_SHA" --artifact-repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
            --from-release-commit "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA" \
            --decision "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source/.callisto/release-decision.json" \
            --out "$handoff_dir/release-intent.json"
          # Relative name: the consumers verify from a different runner OS and RUNNER_TEMP.
          (cd "$handoff_dir" && shasum -a 256 release-intent.json > release-intent.json.sha256)
      - name: Read declared artifact slot count
        id: slots
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # Own statement: set -e cannot see a substitution failing inside an echo argument.
          has_artifacts=$(jq '.artifactSlots | length > 0' "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent/release-intent.json")
          case "$has_artifacts" in
            true|false) ;;
            *) echo "::error::artifact slot probe returned '$has_artifacts'"; exit 1 ;;
          esac
          echo "has_artifacts=$has_artifacts" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
          if-no-files-found: error
          # 1 day was too short: a stuck run needing "execute" re-run days
          # later (e.g. while a workflow bug gets diagnosed and fixed) loses
          # this artifact before the fix even lands, forcing a full rerun
          # instead of just the failed job.
          retention-days: 7

  build-artifact:
    name: Build ${{ matrix.target }} from the intent-bound source tree
    needs: [plan, release-candidate]
    if: always() && needs.plan.result == 'success' && needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - id: macos-arm64
            runner: macos-15
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            asset: callisto-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: macos-x64
            runner: macos-15
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            asset: callisto-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: linux-gnu
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            asset: callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: linux-arm64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            asset: callisto-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: linux-musl
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            asset: callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz
            kind: cross
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      attestations: write
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          path: release-source
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
      - name: Verify handoff
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          handoff_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          (cd "$handoff_dir" && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)
          callisto release inspect --input "$handoff_dir/release-intent.json"
          mkdir -p "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-artifacts"
      - name: Build declared artifact
        env:
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_KIND: ${{ matrix.kind }}
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_ASSET: ${{ matrix.asset }}
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}/release-source
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts
        run: |
          bash .github/scripts/build-release-artifact.sh
      - name: Attest exact artifact bytes
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts/${{ matrix.asset }}
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-build-${{ matrix.id }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts/${{ matrix.asset }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          # 1 day was too short: a stuck run needing "execute" re-run days
          # later (e.g. while a workflow bug gets diagnosed and fixed) loses
          # this artifact before the fix even lands, forcing a full rerun
          # instead of just the failed job.
          retention-days: 7

  build:
    name: Assemble attested product artifacts
    needs: [build-artifact, release-candidate, plan]
    if: always() && needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true' && needs.build-artifact.result == 'success'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    outputs:
      orchestration_sha: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
      release_source_sha: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
      # Every matrix target's artifact, so a target added to the matrix cannot be built and then left out of the manifest.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          pattern: release-build-*
          merge-multiple: true
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts
      - name: Create exact artifact manifest
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          callisto release artifact-manifest --intent "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent/release-intent.json" --artifact-dir "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-artifacts" --out "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-artifacts/manifest.json"
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: release-build
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
            ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifacts
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  execute:
    name: Execute approved release
    needs: [plan, build, release-candidate]
    # Artifact-less sources skip build; a failed or cancelled build must still block.
    # !cancelled() not always(): a status function still defeats the skipped-ancestor
    # rule, but cancelling the run must stop the one irreversible job.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.plan.result == 'success' &&
      (needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'false' || needs.build.result == 'success')
    timeout-minutes: 60
    concurrency:
      group: release-execute
      cancel-in-progress: false
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      attestations: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
          path: release-source
          fetch-depth: 0
          # The release-source checkout alone needs Git credentials because
          # graph-owned tag dispatch pushes from this repository.
          persist-credentials: true
      # Downloaded outside the workspace (under $RUNNER_TEMP, like
      # setup-callisto's own binary install): callisto release execute
      # re-checks release trust before every dispatch, which requires a
      # worktree with no tracked or untracked files -- landing these inside
      # the checkout would dirty it and fail that check before anything
      # gets published.
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-intent
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-intent
      - if: needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts == 'true'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: release-build
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-build
      - name: Verify same-run handoff before credentials
        env:
          HAS_ARTIFACTS: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.has_artifacts }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          intent_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          build_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-build"
          (cd "$intent_dir" && shasum -a 256 -c release-intent.json.sha256)
          if [[ "$HAS_ARTIFACTS" == true ]]; then
            cmp "$intent_dir/release-intent.json" "$build_dir/release-intent/release-intent.json"
          fi
      - name: Execute verified release
        env:
          CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          ORCHESTRATION_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.orchestration_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          intent_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-intent"
          build_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-build"
          receipt_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-release-receipt/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}"
          mkdir -p "$receipt_dir"
          args=(--source-root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/release-source" --intent "$intent_dir/release-intent.json" --receipt "$receipt_dir/release-receipt.json" --orchestration-revision "$ORCHESTRATION_SHA")
          if [[ -f "$build_dir/release-artifacts/manifest.json" ]]; then
            args+=(--artifact-manifest "$build_dir/release-artifacts/manifest.json" --artifact-dir "$build_dir/release-artifacts")
          fi
          callisto release execute "${args[@]}"
      # Needs no secrets: a plain tag push with the checkout's Git credentials, like the release tags. A no-op before 1.0.0.
      - name: Move the floating major tag
        working-directory: release-source
        env:
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
        run: bash "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.github/scripts/move-floating-tag.sh" .callisto/release-decision.json cargo/callisto-cli "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA"
      - name: Summarize receipt
        if: always()
        run: |
          receipt="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-release-receipt/${GITHUB_RUN_ID}/release-receipt.json"
          if [[ -f "$receipt" ]]; then
            {
              echo '### Release receipt'
              echo '```json'
              cat "$receipt"
              echo '```'
            } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi
      - name: Upload receipt
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          # Per attempt: keeps each attempt's receipt instead of shadowing the prior one.
          name: release-receipt-attempt-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/callisto-release-receipt/${{ github.run_id }}
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  drain:
    name: Start the next unfinished release
    needs: [execute, release-candidate]
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.execute.result == 'success' &&
      needs.release-candidate.outputs.is_release_pr == 'true'
    timeout-minutes: 15
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      actions: write
      contents: read
    outputs:
      has_pending: ${{ steps.pending.outputs.has_pending }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-callisto
        with:
          source: local
      - name: Dispatch the oldest unfinished release
        id: pending
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.release-candidate.outputs.release_source_sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          # The release just executed is excluded: a release that cannot be read back as finished must not start itself again.
          next_sha=$(callisto --format json release pending | jq -r --arg sha "$RELEASE_SOURCE_SHA" '[.pending[] | select(.source != $sha)][0].source // empty')
          if [[ -n "$next_sha" ]]; then
            gh workflow run callisto-release.yml --ref main -f release_source_sha="$next_sha"
            echo 'has_pending=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo 'has_pending=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

name: Callisto CI & Validation

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  merge_group:

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  workflow-contracts:
    name: Workflow Contracts
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install workflow validation tools
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@86f7a0ffb25f40114606501a311ebcfaf882ea32 # v2
        with:
          tool: ripgrep,zizmor@1.30.0
      - name: Lint workflow and action metadata
        # actionlint v1.7.12 predates GitHub's documented $/ self-repository
        # syntax. Keep all other actionlint diagnostics strict.
        uses: docker://rhysd/actionlint@sha256:9d36088643581e728c969f35141f88139fec77280b2be23c1f66f8e40e1025e7 # v1.7.12
        with:
          # Docker action arguments are passed directly, rather than through a
          # shell. Keep the exception as one argument so its regex is intact.
          args: -color -ignore=\$/.+
      - name: Install just
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@86f7a0ffb25f40114606501a311ebcfaf882ea32 # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0
      - name: Audit workflow and action security
        run: just zizmor
      - name: Verify workflow contracts
        run: just workflow-contracts

  fmt:
    name: Code Formatting (Moon & Just)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@86f7a0ffb25f40114606501a311ebcfaf882ea32 # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0
      - uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@261c62cb5b0f580c7be7c8cd0f023a2e96756095 # v0
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          components: rustfmt
      - run: just fmt-check

  clippy:
    name: Clippy Lints (Moon & Just)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@86f7a0ffb25f40114606501a311ebcfaf882ea32 # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0
      - uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@261c62cb5b0f580c7be7c8cd0f023a2e96756095 # v0
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          components: clippy
      - run: just lint
      - run: just doc-check
      - run: just fuzz-check

  msrv:
    name: Minimum Supported Rust Version
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Install the declared rust-version
        run: |
          msrv=$(sed -n 's/^rust-version = "\(.*\)"/\1/p' Cargo.toml)
          rustup toolchain install "$msrv" --profile minimal
          echo "RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=$msrv" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
      - run: cargo check --workspace --all-targets --locked

  test:
    name: Test Suite (${{ matrix.os }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@86f7a0ffb25f40114606501a311ebcfaf882ea32 # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0
      - uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@261c62cb5b0f580c7be7c8cd0f023a2e96756095 # v0
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@86f7a0ffb25f40114606501a311ebcfaf882ea32 # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-nextest
      - name: Install workflow linters
        uses: $/.github/actions/install-workflow-linters
      - name: Install registry test tools
        uses: $/.github/actions/install-registry-test-tools
      - run: just test
      - run: just release-workflow-behavior
      - name: Verify Release-PR action against the real callisto binary
        run: bash .github/actions/callisto-action/tests/test_release_pr_decide_binary_contract.sh
      - name: Verify the problem matcher against the real callisto error
        run: bash .github/tests/test-problem-matcher.sh

  release-artifact-preflight:
    name: Release Artifact Preflight (${{ matrix.id }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 45
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - id: macos-arm64
            runner: macos-15
            target: aarch64-apple-darwin
            asset: callisto-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: macos-x64
            runner: macos-15
            target: x86_64-apple-darwin
            asset: callisto-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: linux-gnu
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu
            asset: callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: linux-arm64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            target: aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu
            asset: callisto-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz
            kind: cli
          - id: linux-musl
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            target: x86_64-unknown-linux-musl
            asset: callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz
            kind: cross
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
      - name: Build the production artifact recipe
        env:
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_KIND: ${{ matrix.kind }}
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_ASSET: ${{ matrix.asset }}
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT: ${{ github.workspace }}
          CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_DIR: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-artifact-preflight
        run: bash .github/scripts/build-release-artifact.sh

  coverage:
    name: Code Coverage & Test Report
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@86f7a0ffb25f40114606501a311ebcfaf882ea32 # v2
        with:
          tool: just@1.58.0
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
        with:
          components: llvm-tools-preview
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@86f7a0ffb25f40114606501a311ebcfaf882ea32 # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-llvm-cov
      - name: Install workflow linters
        uses: $/.github/actions/install-workflow-linters
      # Measures lines only: the Test Suite job installs the real-registry tools and runs those tests for real.
      - run: just coverage 90
        env:
          CALLISTO_ALLOW_MISSING_TOOLS: "1"
      # The workspace total can pass while a small crate is far below threshold, because a few large crates dominate
      # the line count, so each crate is held to the same floor.
      - run: just coverage-per-crate 90

  hygiene:
    name: Dependency & API Hygiene
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:

name: Callisto Quality Sweeps

# Slow checks that find what the per-PR gates cannot: parsers fed hostile input, and tests that pass without asserting
# anything. They report; they do not block a merge.
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: "41 3 * * 0"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  fuzz:
    name: Fuzz ${{ matrix.target }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        target: [manifest_editor, manifest_identity, parse_changeset, parse_package_id]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@86f7a0ffb25f40114606501a311ebcfaf882ea32 # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-fuzz
      - name: Install nightly
        run: rustup toolchain install nightly --profile minimal
      - name: Fuzz for ten minutes
        working-directory: fuzz
        env:
          TARGET: ${{ matrix.target }}
        run: cargo +nightly fuzz run "$TARGET" -- -max_total_time=600
      - name: Keep the crashing input
        if: failure()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: fuzz-crash-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: fuzz/artifacts/${{ matrix.target }}
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  mutants:
    name: Mutants, shard ${{ matrix.shard }} of 6
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 120
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db # v1.1
      - uses: taiki-e/install-action@86f7a0ffb25f40114606501a311ebcfaf882ea32 # v2
        with:
          tool: cargo-mutants
      # A surviving mutant means a change to that line would pass every test: report it, do not fail the sweep.
      - name: Mutate the libraries that hold the parsing and version rules
        env:
          SHARD: ${{ matrix.shard }}
        run: cargo mutants -p callisto-model -p callisto-manifests --shard "$SHARD/6" --timeout 120 || [ $? -eq 2 ]
      - name: Summarize
        if: always()
        run: |
          {
            echo "### Surviving mutants, shard ${{ matrix.shard }}"
            if [ -f mutants.out/missed.txt ]; then
              echo '```'
              cat mutants.out/missed.txt
              echo '```'
            else
              echo "none recorded"
            fi
          } >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
      - name: Keep the results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: mutants-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}
          path: mutants.out
          if-no-files-found: ignore

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Build one declared Callisto product artifact. This script deliberately owns
# only platform compilation and archive layout; Callisto owns all release
# planning, artifact identity, provenance verification, and publication.
set -euo pipefail

: "${CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_KIND:?must name cli or cross}"
: "${CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_TARGET:?must name a supported Rust target}"
: "${CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_ASSET:?must name the expected release asset}"
: "${CALLISTO_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT:?must name the checked-out source root}"
: "${CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_DIR:?must name an output directory}"

kind="$CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_KIND"
target="$CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_TARGET"
asset="$CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_ASSET"
source_root="$CALLISTO_RELEASE_SOURCE_ROOT"
artifact_dir="$CALLISTO_RELEASE_ARTIFACT_DIR"

case "$kind:$target:$asset" in
  cli:aarch64-apple-darwin:callisto-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz | \
  cli:x86_64-apple-darwin:callisto-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz | \
  cli:x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu:callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz | \
  cli:aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu:callisto-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz | \
  cross:x86_64-unknown-linux-musl:callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz)
    ;;
  *)
    printf 'unsupported Callisto release artifact: kind=%s target=%s asset=%s\n' \
      "$kind" "$target" "$asset" >&2
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

mkdir -p "$artifact_dir"

case "$kind" in
  cli)
    rustup target add "$target"
    (cd "$source_root" && cargo build --locked --release -p callisto-cli --target "$target")
    tar -C "$source_root/target/$target/release" -czf "$artifact_dir/$asset" callisto
    ;;
  cross)
    rustup target add "$target"
    cargo install cross --locked --version 0.2.5
    (cd "$source_root" && cross build --locked --release -p callisto-cli --target "$target")
    tar -C "$source_root/target/$target/release" -czf "$artifact_dir/$asset" callisto
    ;;
esac

2	# Drafts the open managed release PR as soon as main moves, because a draft cannot be merged. The release
3	# workflow marks it ready again only after a refresh built from the new tip, so a failed or skipped refresh
4	# leaves a stale release PR unmergeable instead of mergeable. Usage: hold-release-pr.sh <release-branch>
5	# Needs GH_TOKEN and GITHUB_REPOSITORY.
6	set -euo pipefail
7

9

11	numbers=$(jq -r --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --arg branch "$release_branch" '
12	  .[] | select(.isDraft == false
13	    and (.headRepository.nameWithOwner // "") == $repo
14	    and (.headRefName == $branch or (.headRefName | startswith($branch + "--")))) | .number' <<< "$prs")
15	
16	for number in $numbers; do
17	  for attempt in 1 2 3; do
18	    if gh pr ready "$number" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --undo; then
19	      echo "::notice::Held release PR #$number as a draft until the release workflow refreshes it"
20	      break
21	    fi

23	    sleep $((attempt * 2))
24	  done

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Drafts the open managed release PR as soon as main moves, because a draft cannot be merged. The release
# workflow marks it ready again only after a refresh built from the new tip, so a failed or skipped refresh
# leaves a stale release PR unmergeable instead of mergeable. Usage: hold-release-pr.sh <release-branch>
# Needs GH_TOKEN and GITHUB_REPOSITORY.
set -euo pipefail

release_branch="${1:?usage: hold-release-pr.sh <release-branch>}"

prs=$(gh pr list --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --state open --limit 1000 --json number,isDraft,headRefName,headRepository)
numbers=$(jq -r --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --arg branch "$release_branch" '
  .[] | select(.isDraft == false
    and (.headRepository.nameWithOwner // "") == $repo
    and (.headRefName == $branch or (.headRefName | startswith($branch + "--")))) | .number' <<< "$prs")

for number in $numbers; do
  for attempt in 1 2 3; do
    if gh pr ready "$number" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --undo; then
      echo "::notice::Held release PR #$number as a draft until the release workflow refreshes it"
      break
    fi
    [[ $attempt -lt 3 ]] || { echo "::error::could not draft release PR #$number"; exit 1; }
    sleep $((attempt * 2))
  done
done

20	  exit 0

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Moves the floating major tag (v1, v2, ...) to a release commit, for a stable release at or past 1.0.0.
# Run inside the release-source checkout, after the release succeeded, so `uses: ...@v1` follows the newest 1.x.
# Usage: move-floating-tag.sh <release-decision.json> <package> <commit> [remote]
set -euo pipefail

decision="${1:?usage: move-floating-tag.sh <release-decision.json> <package> <commit> [remote]}"
package="${2:?missing package}"
commit="${3:?missing commit}"
remote="${4:-origin}"

if [[ ! "$commit" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
  echo "::error::commit must be exactly 40 lowercase hex characters"
  exit 1
fi

version=$(jq -r --arg package "$package" '[.entries[] | select(.package == $package) | .targetVersion][0] // empty' "$decision")
if [[ -z "$version" ]]; then
  echo "$package is not in this release; no floating tag to move"
  exit 0
fi
if [[ ! "$version" =~ ^([0-9]+)\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
  echo "$version is not a stable X.Y.Z version; no floating tag to move"
  exit 0
fi
major="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
if ((major < 1)); then
  echo "$version is before 1.0.0; no floating tag to move"
  exit 0
fi
tag="v$major"

current=$(git ls-remote --tags "$remote" "refs/tags/$tag" | awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }')
if [[ "$current" == "$commit" ]]; then
  echo "$tag already points at $commit"
  exit 0
fi
if [[ -n "$current" ]]; then
  # A recovery run of an older release must not drag the tag backwards.
  git fetch --quiet "$remote" "refs/tags/$tag:refs/tags/$tag" --force
  if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$current" "$commit"; then
    echo "$tag points at $current, which is not an ancestor of $commit; leaving it"
    exit 0
  fi
fi

git tag --force "$tag" "$commit"
git push --force "$remote" "refs/tags/$tag"
echo "$tag now points at $commit ($package $version)"

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Drafts the open managed release PR as soon as main moves, because a draft cannot be merged. The release
3	# workflow marks it ready again only after a refresh built from the new tip, so a failed or skipped refresh
4	# leaves a stale release PR unmergeable instead of mergeable. Usage: hold-release-pr.sh <release-branch>
5	# Needs GH_TOKEN and GITHUB_REPOSITORY.
6	set -euo pipefail
7	
8	release_branch="${1:?usage: hold-release-pr.sh <release-branch>}"
9	
10	prs=$(gh pr list --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --state open --limit 1000 --json number,isDraft,headRefName,headRepository)
11	numbers=$(jq -r --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --arg branch "$release_branch" '
12	  .[] | select(.isDraft == false
13	    and (.headRepository.nameWithOwner // "") == $repo
14	    and (.headRefName == $branch or (.headRefName | startswith($branch + "--")))) | .number' <<< "$prs")
15	
16	for number in $numbers; do
17	  for attempt in 1 2 3; do
18	    if gh pr ready "$number" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --undo; then
19	      echo "::notice::Held release PR #$number as a draft until the release workflow refreshes it"
20	      break
21	    fi
22	    [[ $attempt -lt 3 ]] || { echo "::error::could not draft release PR #$number"; exit 1; }
23	    sleep $((attempt * 2))
24	  done
25	done

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Moves the floating major tag (v1, v2, ...) to a release commit, for a stable release at or past 1.0.0.
3	# Run inside the release-source checkout, after the release succeeded, so `uses: ...@v1` follows the newest 1.x.
4	# Usage: move-floating-tag.sh <release-decision.json> <package> <commit> [remote]
5	set -euo pipefail
6	
7	decision="${1:?usage: move-floating-tag.sh <release-decision.json> <package> <commit> [remote]}"
8	package="${2:?missing package}"
9	commit="${3:?missing commit}"
10	remote="${4:-origin}"
11	
12	if [[ ! "$commit" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
13	  echo "::error::commit must be exactly 40 lowercase hex characters"
14	  exit 1
15	fi
16	
17	version=$(jq -r --arg package "$package" '[.entries[] | select(.package == $package) | .targetVersion][0] // empty' "$decision")
18	if [[ -z "$version" ]]; then
19	  echo "$package is not in this release; no floating tag to move"
20	  exit 0
21	fi
22	if [[ ! "$version" =~ ^([0-9]+)\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
23	  echo "$version is not a stable X.Y.Z version; no floating tag to move"
24	  exit 0
25	fi
26	major="${BASH_REMATCH[1]}"
27	if ((major < 1)); then
28	  echo "$version is before 1.0.0; no floating tag to move"
29	  exit 0
30	fi
31	tag="v$major"
32	
33	current=$(git ls-remote --tags "$remote" "refs/tags/$tag" | awk 'NR == 1 { print $1 }')
34	if [[ "$current" == "$commit" ]]; then
35	  echo "$tag already points at $commit"
36	  exit 0
37	fi
38	if [[ -n "$current" ]]; then
39	  # A recovery run of an older release must not drag the tag backwards.
40	  git fetch --quiet "$remote" "refs/tags/$tag:refs/tags/$tag" --force
41	  if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$current" "$commit"; then
42	    echo "$tag points at $current, which is not an ancestor of $commit; leaving it"
43	    exit 0
44	  fi
45	fi
46	
47	git tag --force "$tag" "$commit"
48	git push --force "$remote" "refs/tags/$tag"
49	echo "$tag now points at $commit ($package $version)"

# Behavior test for .github/scripts/hold-release-pr.sh with a stubbed gh.
set -u
script="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../scripts" && pwd)/hold-release-pr.sh"
fail=0

run_case() { # <pr list json> [failing ready attempts]
  local calls harness count
  calls="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/callisto.XXXXXX")"
  harness="$(mktemp "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/callisto.XXXXXX")"
  count="$calls.count"
  cat > "$harness" <<'STUBS'
gh() {
  echo "gh $*" >> "$CALLS_FILE"
  case "$1 $2" in
    'pr list') printf '%s\n' "$PR_LIST" ;;
    'pr ready')
      local seen=$(( $(cat "$READY_COUNT_FILE" 2>/dev/null || echo 0) + 1 ))
      echo "$seen" > "$READY_COUNT_FILE"
      [[ "$seen" -gt "${READY_FAILS:-0}" ]] || return 1 ;;
  esac
}
sleep() { echo "sleep $*" >> "$CALLS_FILE"; }
STUBS
  CALLS_FILE="$calls" PR_LIST="$1" READY_FAILS="${2:-0}" READY_COUNT_FILE="$count" GITHUB_REPOSITORY='orin-dx/callisto' \
    bash -c 'source "$1"; source "$2" callisto/version-packages' -- "$harness" "$script" > /dev/null 2>&1

}

verdict 'an already-draft release PR is left alone' "$ok"

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Installs or builds the Callisto binary. Factored out of action.yml so
3	# callisto-action's own environment setup can call it directly by path
4	# (github.action_path has no ref-ambiguous `uses:` to resolve), instead of
5	# duplicating this logic.
6	set -euo pipefail
7	
8	# Install into $RUNNER_TEMP so the binary never lands inside the workspace
9	# tree (preventing accidental git-staging by downstream steps that run
10	# "git add -A").
11	CALLISTO_BIN_DIR="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-bin"
12	mkdir -p "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR"
13	TAG_NAME="$INPUT_CALLISTO_VERSION"
14	SOURCE="$INPUT_CALLISTO_SOURCE"
15	
16	if [[ "$SOURCE" != "auto" && "$SOURCE" != "local" ]]; then
17	  echo "::error::unsupported setup-callisto source '$SOURCE' (expected auto or local)"
18	  exit 1
19	fi
20	
21	# With no explicit version override, install the release this action's own
22	# invocation is pinned to (GITHUB_ACTION_REF, github.action_ref) rather than
23	# whatever is newest, so `callisto-action@<sha> # callisto@X.Y.Z` always
24	# installs X.Y.Z. Falls back to true "latest" when the ref is unset (local or
25	# unpinned invocation) or matches no published callisto@ tag; a failed tag
26	# lookup fails the step. A named ref such as the floating `v1` tag stands for
27	# the commit it points at.
28	if [[ "$SOURCE" == "auto" && "$TAG_NAME" == "latest" && -n "${GITHUB_ACTION_REF:-}" ]]; then
29	  if ! remote_tags=$(git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto.git 'callisto@*' "$GITHUB_ACTION_REF"); then
30	    echo "::error::could not list callisto release tags to resolve action ref $GITHUB_ACTION_REF; set the version input to install a specific release"
31	    exit 1
32	  fi
33	  ref_commit=$(printf '%s\n' "$remote_tags" \
34	    | awk -v ref="refs/tags/$GITHUB_ACTION_REF" '$2 == ref || $2 == ref "^{}" { sha = $1 } END { print sha }')
35	  resolved_tag=$(printf '%s\n' "$remote_tags" \
36	    | awk -v ref="${ref_commit:-$GITHUB_ACTION_REF}" '$1 == ref && $2 ~ /^refs\/tags\/callisto@/ { print $2 }' \
37	    | sed -e 's#^refs/tags/##' -e 's/\^{}$//' \
38	    | sort -V | tail -n1) || true
39	  if [[ -n "$resolved_tag" ]]; then
40	    echo "Resolved action ref $GITHUB_ACTION_REF to $resolved_tag"
41	    TAG_NAME="$resolved_tag"
42	  fi
43	fi
44

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Installs or builds the Callisto binary. Factored out of action.yml so
# callisto-action's own environment setup can call it directly by path
# (github.action_path has no ref-ambiguous `uses:` to resolve), instead of
# duplicating this logic.
set -euo pipefail

# Install into $RUNNER_TEMP so the binary never lands inside the workspace
# tree (preventing accidental git-staging by downstream steps that run
# "git add -A").
CALLISTO_BIN_DIR="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-bin"
mkdir -p "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR"
TAG_NAME="$INPUT_CALLISTO_VERSION"
SOURCE="$INPUT_CALLISTO_SOURCE"

if [[ "$SOURCE" != "auto" && "$SOURCE" != "local" ]]; then
  echo "::error::unsupported setup-callisto source '$SOURCE' (expected auto or local)"
  exit 1
fi

# With no explicit version override, install the release this action's own
# invocation is pinned to (GITHUB_ACTION_REF, github.action_ref) rather than
# whatever is newest, so `callisto-action@<sha> # callisto@X.Y.Z` always
# installs X.Y.Z. Falls back to true "latest" when the ref is unset (local or
# unpinned invocation) or matches no published callisto@ tag; a failed tag
# lookup fails the step. A named ref such as the floating `v1` tag stands for
# the commit it points at.
if [[ "$SOURCE" == "auto" && "$TAG_NAME" == "latest" && -n "${GITHUB_ACTION_REF:-}" ]]; then
  if ! remote_tags=$(git ls-remote --tags https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto.git 'callisto@*' "$GITHUB_ACTION_REF"); then
    echo "::error::could not list callisto release tags to resolve action ref $GITHUB_ACTION_REF; set the version input to install a specific release"
    exit 1
  fi
  ref_commit=$(printf '%s\n' "$remote_tags" \
    | awk -v ref="refs/tags/$GITHUB_ACTION_REF" '$2 == ref || $2 == ref "^{}" { sha = $1 } END { print sha }')
  resolved_tag=$(printf '%s\n' "$remote_tags" \
    | awk -v ref="${ref_commit:-$GITHUB_ACTION_REF}" '$1 == ref && $2 ~ /^refs\/tags\/callisto@/ { print $2 }' \
    | sed -e 's#^refs/tags/##' -e 's/\^{}$//' \
    | sort -V | tail -n1) || true
  if [[ -n "$resolved_tag" ]]; then
    echo "Resolved action ref $GITHUB_ACTION_REF to $resolved_tag"
    TAG_NAME="$resolved_tag"
  fi
fi

# Validate verification mode
VERIFICATION="${INPUT_CALLISTO_VERIFICATION:-fallback}"
case "$VERIFICATION" in
  require|fallback|skip) ;;
  *)
    echo "::error::unsupported setup-callisto verification '$VERIFICATION' (valid values: require, fallback, skip)"
    exit 1
    ;;
esac

# Detect OS platform architecture for pre-built binaries
OS_NAME=$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')
ARCH_NAME=$(uname -m)

if [[ "$OS_NAME" == "darwin" ]]; then
  case "$ARCH_NAME" in
    arm64) ASSET_NAME="callisto-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz" ;;
    x86_64) ASSET_NAME="callisto-x86_64-apple-darwin.tar.gz" ;;
    *) ASSET_NAME="" ;;
  esac
elif [[ "$OS_NAME" == "linux" ]]; then
  case "$ARCH_NAME" in
    x86_64) ASSET_NAME="callisto-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz" ;;
    aarch64 | arm64) ASSET_NAME="callisto-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz" ;;
    *) ASSET_NAME="" ;;
  esac
elif [[ "$OS_NAME" == *"mingw"* || "$OS_NAME" == *"msys"* || "$OS_NAME" == *"windows"* ]]; then
  ASSET_NAME=""
else
  ASSET_NAME=""
fi

if [[ -n "$ASSET_NAME" && "$TAG_NAME" == "latest" ]]; then
  DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto/releases/latest/download/$ASSET_NAME"
elif [[ -n "$ASSET_NAME" ]]; then
  DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/orin-dx/callisto/releases/download/$TAG_NAME/$ASSET_NAME"
fi

# Derive a crates.io version spec from TAG_NAME: "latest" installs
# whatever crates.io resolves as latest (no --version flag); an
# explicit tag ("callisto@0.5.0" or legacy "callisto-cli@0.5.0")
# strips either prefix down to the bare semver cargo install expects.
CRATE_VERSION="${TAG_NAME#callisto@}"; CRATE_VERSION="${CRATE_VERSION#callisto-cli@}"

# Pick a download destination whose extension matches ASSET_NAME
# (under $RUNNER_TEMP, never the workspace) so the extraction step
# below always has an archive it can actually open -- a hardcoded
# ".tar.gz" path here previously masked the fact that Windows assets
# are zip files, since tar -xzf can't read a zip regardless of what
# the file on disk is really named.
case "$ASSET_NAME" in
  *.zip)
    DOWNLOAD_DEST="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto.zip"
    ;;
  *.tar.gz)
    DOWNLOAD_DEST="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto.tar.gz"
    ;;
  *)
    DOWNLOAD_DEST="${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto.tar.gz"
    ;;
esac

# A prebuilt asset runs with the job's privileges, so it must carry a
# GitHub attestation from the Callisto release workflow before it is
# extracted. require aborts on failure; fallback discards the asset and
# returns 1 so the crates.io path runs; skip trusts the asset.
verify_asset() {
  local reason=""
  if [[ "$VERIFICATION" == "skip" ]]; then
    echo "::warning::verification=skip: $ASSET_NAME was not verified"
    return 0
  fi
  if ! command -v gh >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    reason="gh is not installed"
  elif ! gh attestation verify "$DOWNLOAD_DEST" \
      --repo orin-dx/callisto \
      --signer-workflow orin-dx/callisto/.github/workflows/callisto-release.yml \
      --deny-self-hosted-runners; then
    reason="attestation verification failed"
  fi
  [[ -z "$reason" ]] && return 0
  rm -f "$DOWNLOAD_DEST"
  if [[ "$VERIFICATION" == "require" ]]; then
    echo "::error::cannot verify $ASSET_NAME: $reason (verification=require)"
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "::warning::cannot verify $ASSET_NAME: $reason; discarding it and installing from crates.io (verification=fallback)"
  return 1
}

# Download, verify and extract the prebuilt asset; nonzero means use the fallback chain.
fetch_prebuilt() {
  curl -sL -f "$DOWNLOAD_URL" -o "$DOWNLOAD_DEST" 2>/dev/null || return 1
  verify_asset || return 1
  # Extract only the expected binary, never the whole archive.
  case "$ASSET_NAME" in
    *.zip)
      unzip -q "$DOWNLOAD_DEST" callisto.exe -d "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR"
      ;;
    *)
      tar -xzf "$DOWNLOAD_DEST" -C "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR" callisto
      ;;
  esac
}

# Dependencies named callisto-cli do not establish checkout source ownership.
owns_local_source() {
  local workspace git_root metadata
  workspace=$(cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" && pwd -P) || return 1
  git_root=$(git -C "$workspace" rev-parse --show-toplevel) || return 1
  [[ "$git_root" == "$workspace" ]] || return 1
  git -C "$workspace" ls-files --error-unmatch -- \
    Cargo.toml crates/callisto-cli/Cargo.toml crates/callisto-cli/src/main.rs >/dev/null || return 1
  metadata=$(cargo metadata --locked --offline --no-deps --format-version 1 \
    --manifest-path "$workspace/Cargo.toml") || return 1
  jq -e --arg workspace "$workspace" '
    .workspace_root == $workspace and
    (.workspace_members as $members | [.packages[] |
      select(.name == "callisto-cli" and .source == null and
        .manifest_path == ($workspace + "/crates/callisto-cli/Cargo.toml") and
        (.id as $id | $members | index($id) != null) and
        any(.targets[]; .name == "callisto" and (.kind | index("bin") != null) and
          .src_path == ($workspace + "/crates/callisto-cli/src/main.rs")))] | length == 1)
  ' <<< "$metadata" >/dev/null
}

if [[ "$SOURCE" == "local" ]]; then
  if ! owns_local_source; then
    echo "::error::setup-callisto source=local requires a Callisto workspace checkout; check out Callisto source or use source=auto"
    exit 1
  fi
  echo "Building local callisto binary from current repository commit..."
  cargo build --locked --manifest-path "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/Cargo.toml" -p callisto-cli \
    --bin callisto --target-dir "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target"
  cp "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/target/debug/callisto" "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR/callisto"
elif [[ -n "$ASSET_NAME" ]] && fetch_prebuilt; then
  echo "Callisto downloaded from GitHub Releases ($DOWNLOAD_URL)"
elif [[ "$TAG_NAME" == "latest" ]] && cargo install callisto-cli --locked --root "${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-cargo-install" --quiet; then
  echo "Callisto installed from crates.io (latest)"
  cp "${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-cargo-install/bin/callisto" "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR/callisto"
elif [[ "$TAG_NAME" != "latest" ]] && cargo install callisto-cli --version "$CRATE_VERSION" --locked --root "${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-cargo-install" --quiet; then
  echo "Callisto installed from crates.io ($CRATE_VERSION)"
  cp "${RUNNER_TEMP}/callisto-cargo-install/bin/callisto" "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR/callisto"
else
  echo "::error::callisto $TAG_NAME is available neither as a prebuilt asset nor on crates.io"
  exit 1
fi

echo "$CALLISTO_BIN_DIR" >> $GITHUB_PATH
if [[ -f "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.github/callisto-problem-matcher.json" ]]; then
  echo "::add-matcher::$GITHUB_WORKSPACE/.github/callisto-problem-matcher.json"
fi

name: 'Callisto Release-PR Action'
description: 'Creates or updates a Callisto release PR; durable execution belongs to the repository workflow'
inputs:
  version_command:
    description: 'Version command; defaults to callisto version, which refreshes lockfiles. Callisto appends --emit-decision <decision_path>.'
    required: false
    default: 'callisto version'
  decision_path:
    description: 'Path, relative to cwd, where the version command records the exact release decision this PR carries. Committed alongside the manifest and changelog edits; `callisto release plan --from-release-commit` verifies the merged commit against this file rather than re-deriving release policy.'
    required: false
    default: '.callisto/release-decision.json'
  commit_message:
    description: 'Release-PR commit message'
    required: false
    default: 'chore(release): version packages'
  title:
    description: 'Release-PR title'
    required: false
    default: 'chore(release): version packages'
  pr_label:
    description: 'Release-PR label'
    required: false
    default: 'callisto: release'
  branch:
    description: 'Base branch for the release PR'
    required: false
    default: 'main'
  release_branch:
    description: 'Branch managed for the release PR'
    required: false
    default: 'callisto/version-packages'
  github_token:
    description: 'Optional GitHub token for pull-request and forge commit API operations. The managed branch is never pushed with `git push`; the default GITHUB_TOKEN is sufficient even on a public repository, since the executor never writes `.github/workflows/*`.'
    required: false
    default: ''
  setup_callisto:
    description: 'Install the Callisto environment before running'
    required: false
    default: 'true'
  version:
    description: >-
      Version tag of Callisto to install. Default 'latest' installs the release this action's own
      invocation is pinned to (github.action_ref resolved against callisto@ tags), falling back to
      the newest published release when that ref is unset or unresolvable.
    required: false
    default: 'latest'
  cwd:
    description: 'Workspace directory'
    required: false
    default: '.'
  mode:
    description: 'version-pr (default): create/update the release PR. release: run `callisto release`.'
    required: false
    default: 'version-pr'
outputs:
  hasChangesets:
    description: 'Whether pending changesets were found (mode: version-pr only)'
    value: ${{ steps.version-pr.outputs.hasChangesets }}
  published:
    description: 'Whether `callisto release` published anything (mode: release only; otherwise false)'
    value: ${{ steps.release.outputs.published || 'false' }}
  publishedPackages:
    description: 'JSON array of packages `callisto release` published (mode: release only; otherwise [])'
    value: ${{ steps.release.outputs.publishedPackages || '[]' }}
runs:
  using: composite
  steps:
    - name: Validate mode
      shell: bash
      env:
        INPUT_MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
      run: bash "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/scripts/validate-mode.sh"
    # setup-callisto's own steps, called directly rather than through its
    # `uses:` (both `$/` and an external owner/repo/path@ref resolve against
    # whichever ref invoked *this* action, not necessarily a real one -- see
    # setup-callisto/scripts/install-callisto.sh's header). github.action_path
    # is this action's own checked-out directory, so a sibling-relative path
    # always uses the same ref this action itself was invoked at.
    - name: Install Rust Toolchain & Cache
      if: inputs.setup_callisto == 'true'
      # orin-dx/actions/setup-rust v1.1
      uses: orin-dx/actions/setup-rust@2521888266780dabc7f5fd4c32b02d6ab82849db
      with:
        components: clippy,rustfmt
        shared-key: "callisto-workspace-shared"
        save-if: "true"
      env:
        CARGO_INCREMENTAL: "0"
        CARGO_REGISTRY_SPARSE: "true"
    - name: Install moon and the .prototools toolchain
      if: inputs.setup_callisto == 'true'
      # moonrepo/setup-toolchain v0
      uses: moonrepo/setup-toolchain@261c62cb5b0f580c7be7c8cd0f023a2e96756095
      with:
        auto-install: true
    - name: Install or Build Callisto Binary
      if: inputs.setup_callisto == 'true'
      shell: bash
      env:
        INPUT_CALLISTO_SOURCE: auto
        INPUT_CALLISTO_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        INPUT_CALLISTO_VERIFICATION: fallback
        GITHUB_ACTION_REF: ${{ github.action_ref }}
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ inputs.github_token || github.token }}
      run: bash "${{ github.action_path }}/../setup-callisto/scripts/install-callisto.sh" # zizmor: ignore[github-env] the PATH entry is a fixed child of the trusted runner temporary directory, not action input or downloaded archive content.
    - name: Create or update release PR
      id: version-pr
      if: inputs.mode == 'version-pr'
      shell: bash
      env:
        INPUT_VERSION_COMMAND: ${{ inputs.version_command }}
        INPUT_DECISION_PATH: ${{ inputs.decision_path }}
        INPUT_COMMIT_MESSAGE: ${{ inputs.commit_message }}
        INPUT_TITLE: ${{ inputs.title }}
        INPUT_PR_LABEL: ${{ inputs.pr_label }}
        INPUT_BRANCH: ${{ inputs.branch }}
        INPUT_RELEASE_BRANCH: ${{ inputs.release_branch }}
        INPUT_CWD: ${{ inputs.cwd }}
        # GitHub exposes the installation token as a context, not a guaranteed
        # inherited environment variable. Using the context also works for the
        # repository workflow that invokes this action after checkout.
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ inputs.github_token || github.token }}
      run: bash "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/scripts/create-or-update-release-pr.sh"
    - name: Run release
      id: release
      if: inputs.mode == 'release'
      shell: bash
      env:
        INPUT_CWD: ${{ inputs.cwd }}
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ inputs.github_token || github.token }}
      run: bash "$GITHUB_ACTION_PATH/scripts/run-release.sh"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Runs `callisto release` (mode: release) and fills published/publishedPackages
# from its receipt; callisto release's own idempotency makes a redundant run a no-op.
set -euo pipefail

cd "$INPUT_CWD"

runtime_dir="$(mktemp -d "${RUNNER_TEMP:-${TMPDIR:-/tmp}}/callisto-release.XXXXXX")"
receipt="$runtime_dir/release-receipt.json"
cleanup() {
  rm -f "$runtime_dir/npmrc" "$receipt"
  rmdir "$runtime_dir" 2>/dev/null || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT

if [[ -n "${NPM_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
  npm_config="${NPM_CONFIG_USERCONFIG:-${HOME:-}/.npmrc}"
  if [[ -n "${HOME:-}" && -f "$npm_config" ]]; then
    cp "$npm_config" "$runtime_dir/npmrc"
  else
    : > "$runtime_dir/npmrc"
  fi
  chmod 600 "$runtime_dir/npmrc"
  printf '\n//registry.npmjs.org/:_authToken=${NPM_TOKEN}\n' >> "$runtime_dir/npmrc"
  export CALLISTO_PUBLISH_NPM_CONFIG="$runtime_dir/npmrc"
fi

if [[ -n "${PYPI_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
  export TWINE_USERNAME=__token__
  export TWINE_PASSWORD="$PYPI_TOKEN"
  unset PYPI_TOKEN
fi

output=$(callisto --format json release --receipt "$receipt")

if jq -e '.nothingToRelease == true' <<< "$output" > /dev/null; then
  echo 'published=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo 'publishedPackages=[]' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
  echo '::notice::Nothing to release.'
  exit 0
fi

packages=$(jq -c '[
    .outcomes[]
    | select(.outcome.kind == "published" and (.operation.role.kind == "registryPublish" or .operation.role.kind == "platformPublish"))
    | .operation.package
  ] | unique' "$receipt")
published=$(jq -r 'length > 0' <<< "$packages")
{
  echo "published=$published"
  echo "publishedPackages=$packages"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# Executes a typed Callisto release-PR decision. Forge reads stay here; all
3	# create/update policy belongs to `callisto release-pr decide`.
4	#
5	# The managed branch is never pushed with the Git wire protocol: on a public
6	# repository, GITHUB_TOKEN cannot write `.github/workflows/*` that way, nor
7	# through createCommitOnBranch's own fileChanges, on any ref (confirmed
8	# directly against this repository). Instead, the generated
9	# version-bump changes are committed via the forge commit API onto a
10	# deterministic staging branch rooted at the current base commit -- which
11	# never needs to touch `.github/workflows/*`, since that path is inherited
12	# unchanged from the base -- and only then is the managed branch's ref moved
13	# onto that commit. A ref move is not itself a write to that path.
14	set -euo pipefail
15	
16	cd "$INPUT_CWD"
17	
18	# This checkout starts on the configured base. Preserve its exact commit for
19	# both observations; the working tree changes below (git add -A) never
20	# create a local commit -- the real commit is made remotely, via the forge
21	# commit API, on the staging branch.
22	base_commit=$(git rev-parse HEAD)
23	
24	# One GitHub 5xx must not strand the release PR until the next push to main: retry transient failures,
25	# print every failed attempt's stderr, and leave other failures (404, 422) to the caller. `gh pr create`
26	# is not wrapped, because a retry after an unseen success would fail on the PR it just made.
27	gh_retry() {
28	  local attempt=1 delay=2 err code
29	  err=$(mktemp)
30	  until gh "$@" 2> "$err"; do
31	    code=$?
32	    cat "$err" >&2
33	    if [[ $attempt -ge 4 ]] || ! grep -qiE 'Something went wrong|HTTP 5[0-9]{2}|Bad Gateway|Service Unavailable|Gateway Time|timed? ?out|connection reset|unexpected EOF' "$err"; then
34	      rm -f "$err"
35	      return "$code"
36	    fi
37	    echo "::warning::gh $1 hit a transient GitHub error (attempt $attempt of 4); retrying in ${delay}s" >&2
38	    sleep "$delay"
39	    delay=$((delay * 2))
40	    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
41	    [[ -z "${RETRY_RESET:-}" ]] || "$RETRY_RESET" || true
42	  done
43	  cat "$err" >&2
44	  rm -f "$err"
45	}
46	
47	release_pr_snapshot() {
48	  local raw_prs
49	  # Command substitutions do not inherit set -e, so a failed read must stop here, not later in jq.
50	  raw_prs=$(gh_retry pr list --state open --base "$INPUT_BRANCH" --limit 1000 --json number,headRefName,headRepository,headRefOid) || return $?
51	  jq -cn \
52	    --arg repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
53	    --arg base_branch "$INPUT_BRANCH" \
54	    --arg base_commit "$base_commit" \
55	    --argjson raw_prs "$raw_prs" \
56	    '{
57	      schemaVersion: 2,
58	      repository: $repository,
59	      baseBranch: $base_branch,
60	      baseCommit: $base_commit,
61	      openPullRequests: [$raw_prs[] | {
62	        number,
63	        headRepository: (.headRepository.nameWithOwner // ""),
64	        headBranch: .headRefName,
65	        headCommit: .headRefOid
66	      }]
67	    }'
68	}
69	
70	# Reads the open PRs first, so a failed read stops with `gh`'s own status instead of becoming an empty --snapshot.
71	verify_current() {
72	  local current
73	  current=$(release_pr_snapshot) || return $?
74	  callisto release-pr verify --decision "$decision" --snapshot "$current" "$@"
75	}
76	
77	snapshot=$(release_pr_snapshot)
78	decision=$(callisto --format json release-pr decide \
79	  --snapshot "$snapshot" \
80	  --repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
81	  --base-branch "$INPUT_BRANCH" \
82	  --release-branch "$INPUT_RELEASE_BRANCH")
83	decision_kind=$(jq -r '.action.kind' <<< "$decision")
84	
85	# A missing key must stop the run: `jq -r` would print `null`, and the script would then move a branch named null.
86	decision_field() {
87	  jq -er "$1" <<< "$decision" || { echo "::error::Callisto's release PR decision has no $1; refusing to guess" >&2; return 1; }
88	}
89	
90	case "$decision_kind" in
91	  noop)
92	    echo 'hasChangesets=false' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
93	    echo '::notice::No changesets. This action does not publish, tag, download artifacts, or create releases; use the durable repository workflow.'
94	    exit 0
95	    ;;
96	  create)
97	    release_branch=$(decision_field '.action.branch')
98	    staging_branch=$(decision_field '.action.stagingBranch')
99	    existing_pr=''
100	    ;;
101	  update)
102	    existing_pr=$(decision_field '.action.pullRequestNumber')
103	    release_branch=$(decision_field '.action.branch')
104	    staging_branch=$(decision_field '.action.stagingBranch')
105	    ;;
106	  *) echo "::error::Callisto returned unsupported release PR decision kind: $decision_kind"; exit 1 ;;
107	esac
108	
109	echo 'hasChangesets=true' >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
110	if [[ -n "$existing_pr" ]]; then
111	  existing_body=$(gh_retry pr view "$existing_pr" --json body --jq '.body')
112	  body=$(printf '%s' "$existing_body" | callisto compose-pr-body --existing-body - --branch "$INPUT_BRANCH" --format text)
113	else
114	  body=$(callisto compose-pr-body --branch "$INPUT_BRANCH" --format text)
115	fi
116	
117	read -ra command <<< "$INPUT_VERSION_COMMAND"
118	command+=(--emit-decision "$INPUT_DECISION_PATH")
119	"${command[@]}"
120	git add -A
121	test -n "$(git status --porcelain)" || { echo '::error::pending changesets produced no release-PR delta'; exit 1; }
122	
123	plan_file=$(mktemp)
124	callisto --format json release-pr commit-plan --base-commit "$base_commit" --message "$INPUT_COMMIT_MESSAGE" --out "$plan_file"
125	local_tree=$(git write-tree)
126	
127	staging_created=false
128	cleanup_staging() {
129	  if [[ "$staging_created" == true ]]; then
130	    gh api -X DELETE "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$staging_branch" > /dev/null 2>&1 \
131	      || echo "::warning::could not delete staging branch $staging_branch; the next run reclaims this deterministic name"
132	  fi
133	  rm -f "$plan_file" body.json
134	}
135	trap cleanup_staging EXIT
136	
137	# A local diff does not authorize a stale forge write. Re-observe immediately
138	# before mutating the remote branch, then again before moving the managed
139	# ref, then again before GitHub label/PR writes.
140	verify_current > /dev/null
141	
142	reset_staging() {
143	  # Cleared so the reset's own retries do not run the reset again, which would recurse for as long as GitHub errs.
144	  RETRY_RESET='' gh_retry api -X PATCH "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$staging_branch" -f sha="$base_commit" -F force=true > /dev/null 2>&1
145	}
146	
147	if reset_staging; then
148	  :
149	else
150	  gh_retry api -X POST "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs" -f ref="refs/heads/$staging_branch" -f sha="$base_commit" > /dev/null
151	fi
152	staging_created=true
153	
154	jq -n \
155	  --arg repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
156	  --arg branch "$staging_branch" \
157	  --arg headline "$INPUT_COMMIT_MESSAGE" \
158	  --slurpfile plan "$plan_file" \
159	  '{
160	    query: "mutation($input: CreateCommitOnBranchInput!) { createCommitOnBranch(input: $input) { commit { oid } } }",
161	    variables: {
162	      input: {
163	        branch: {repositoryNameWithOwner: $repo, branchName: $branch},
164	        message: {headline: $headline},
165	        expectedHeadOid: $plan[0].baseCommit,
166	        fileChanges: {
167	          additions: [$plan[0].additions[] | {path, contents: .contentsBase64}],
168	          deletions: $plan[0].deletions
169	        }
170	      }
171	    }
172	  }' > body.json
173	
174	# A retry may follow a commit the forge made but never acknowledged, which would fail the mutation's
175	# expectedHeadOid, so each retry first puts the staging branch back on the base commit.
176	new_sha=$(RETRY_RESET=reset_staging gh_retry api graphql --input body.json --jq '.data.createCommitOnBranch.commit.oid')
177	remote_tree=$(gh_retry api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/commits/$new_sha" --jq '.tree.sha')
178	if [[ "$remote_tree" != "$local_tree" ]]; then
179	  echo "::error::forge commit tree $remote_tree does not match the locally staged tree $local_tree; refusing to move $release_branch"
180	  exit 1
181	fi
182	
183	verify_current > /dev/null
184	
185	if [[ "$decision_kind" == update ]]; then
186	  gh_retry api -X PATCH "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$release_branch" -f sha="$new_sha" -F force=true > /dev/null
187	else
188	  if ! gh_retry api -X POST "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs" -f ref="refs/heads/$release_branch" -f sha="$new_sha" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
189	    gh_retry api -X PATCH "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$release_branch" -f sha="$new_sha" -F force=true > /dev/null
190	  fi
191	fi
192	moved_sha=$(gh_retry api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/refs/heads/$release_branch" --jq '.object.sha')
193	if [[ "$moved_sha" != "$new_sha" ]]; then
194	  echo "::error::$release_branch points at $moved_sha after the update, expected $new_sha; a concurrent write may have raced this run"
195	  exit 1
196	fi
197	
198	if [[ "$decision_kind" == update ]]; then
199	  # The PR list can lag a ref move by a moment, and a stale read looks like a changed snapshot.
200	  # A real concurrent change stays visible, so the last attempt still fails.
201	  verified=false
202	  for _ in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8 9; do
203	    if verify_current --applied-head "$new_sha" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
204	      verified=true
205	      break
206	    fi
207	    sleep 3
208	  done
209	  if [[ "$verified" != true ]]; then
210	    verify_current --applied-head "$new_sha" > /dev/null
211	  fi
212	else
213	  verify_current > /dev/null
214	fi
215	
216	label_exists=$(gh_retry label list --limit 1000 --json name --jq 'any(.[]; .name == env.INPUT_PR_LABEL)')
217	if [[ "$label_exists" != true ]]; then
218	  gh_retry label create "$INPUT_PR_LABEL" --color 0e8a16 --description 'Callisto release packages'
219	fi
220	
221	case "$decision_kind" in
222	  create)
223	    # Born a draft, so a failed tip check below leaves it unmergeable rather than ready on a stale base.
224	    create_args=(--draft --head "$release_branch" --base "$INPUT_BRANCH" --title "$INPUT_TITLE" --body "$body" --label "$INPUT_PR_LABEL")
225	    pr_url=$(gh pr create "${create_args[@]}")
226	    echo "$pr_url"
227	    pr_number=${pr_url##*/}
228	    ;;
229	  update)
230	    edit_args=(--title "$INPUT_TITLE" --body "$body" --add-label "$INPUT_PR_LABEL")
231	    gh_retry pr edit "$existing_pr" "${edit_args[@]}"
232	    pr_number=$existing_pr
233	    ;;
234	esac
235	
236	# The hold workflow drafts the release PR whenever main moves, because a draft cannot be merged. Hand it back only
237	# when it was built from the current tip; if main moved again during this run, it stays a draft for the next run.
238	is_draft=$(gh_retry pr view "$pr_number" --json isDraft --jq '.isDraft')
239	tip=$(gh_retry api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/ref/heads/$INPUT_BRANCH" --jq '.object.sha')
240	if [[ "$tip" == "$base_commit" ]]; then
241	  if [[ "$is_draft" == true ]]; then gh_retry pr ready "$pr_number"; fi
242	else
243	  echo "::warning::$INPUT_BRANCH moved to $tip while this run built the release PR from $base_commit; leaving it a draft for the next run"
244	  if [[ "$is_draft" != true ]]; then gh_retry pr ready "$pr_number" --undo; fi
245	fi
